evidence.detail: card_history() only populates data[season_id]=True for Legal seasons; all other seasons render as '.' with no distinction between 'card did not exist' and 'card existed but was not chosen'
SetInfo has enter_date_dt (PD season start) but per-season date ranges are not trivially exposed to the bot layer
released_at exists on Set objects (magic/card.py:126) but the Card object passed to card_history() does not surface its earliest set release date directly

triage.notes: Implementing this requires resolving a card's earliest printing date and comparing it to each PD season's calendar window. The season date ranges are in the database (seasons table) but not exposed via a simple API in the bot layer; a new query or helper is needed.
